max_length.description: Maximum prefix length for entries read from stdin; longer prefixes are discarded before processing.

max_opt_length.description: Maximum prefix length for optimisation; longer prefixes are not subject to aggregation.

default_length.description: Default prefix length for bare IP addresses (without /mask). Must be an integer between 1 and 32.

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode: suppress warning messages and other stderr output.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode: output includes line numbers and '+/−' indicators for aggregations and suppressions.
